hypotheses.storyTitle: Review Cash Value & Apply Statement Credits
hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Customer reviews accumulated LBG coins and applies them directly as statement credits to reduce ongoing bills.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer visits the rewards overview to check balance and cashback earnings.
hypotheses.storyTension: Ensuring transparent cash-equivalent valuation and quick application without friction or gamified distractions.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Customer views clear statement credit options and allocates rewards directly toward bill reduction.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Direct visibility of cash-equivalent rewards and progress toward payment utility goals.

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Customer monitors ongoing progress toward active payment utility goals like holiday spending money.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer wants to understand how current points and automatic allocations support financial targets.
hypotheses.storyTension: Maintaining visibility of progress without introducing complex or risky reward-chasing behavior.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Customer reviews clear milestones and guaranteed value conversion rates for active goals.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Direct visibility of cash-equivalent rewards and progress toward payment utility goals.
